assertion.statement: For the actual geometrically nonsimple quaternionic CM surface A/L with all geometric endomorphisms over L, [L:Q]≤576 and rad|D_L|≤R, R≥1, the original stable Faltings height satisfies h_F(A)<854R.
assertion.objects: The same abelian surface A/L, its rational idempotent elliptic factors, a maximal-order CM elliptic quotient Eprime/L and Aambient=(Eprime)^2 over the same L.
assertion.hypotheses: The actual quaternionic division algebra acts on A; A is geometrically nonsimple and all geometric endomorphisms are defined over L; [L:Q]≤576 and rad|D_L|≤R with R≥1. The individual CM embedding height formula, potential good reduction, and GR2023 Theorem1.9(1) are supplied separately.
assertion.quantifiers: For every such actual CM surface and field, with the same R used by the geometric construction.
assertion.parameter_range: Dimension two, elliptic CM factors, field degree at most576; no bound on CM order conductor is assumed.
assertion.uniformity: The resulting coefficient854 is independent of the CM order and the particular L or surface, subject to the stated field and ramification bounds.
assertion.constants: |Delta_F|≤4R; h_F(Eprime)<3R; h_F((Eprime)^2)<6R; Xi=(14^32 [L:Q] max(1,log[L:Q],h_F((Eprime)^2)))^8; degree≤Xi^2; h_F(A)<854R.
assertion.normalizations: Original stable Faltings metric. The quotient to maximal CM order is constructed over the existing L; temporary semistable extensions evaluate stable height only. Apply the general dimension-two isogeny estimate, not a specialized product-isogenous-over-Q case.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Does not construct A or L, prove the full endomorphism-field property, or handle the non-CM branch. No enlargement of the field-degree576 budget. Uses an individual complex-embedding formula, not a class average or a Q(j) Weierstrass assumption.
assertion.limit_order: Fix A/L and R; construct the CM factors and maximal-order quotient over L; bound its original stable height; apply the isogeny estimate over L and then absorb elementary logarithms.
